rule_name: Web Exploit -> Webshell Execution -> Sudo Root Escalation

tree.name: Kiểm tra HTTP Request nghi vấn Exploit
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[r:REQUESTED]->(req:HTTPRequest) WHERE req.method = 'POST' AND (req.uri CONTAINS 'ajax' OR req.uri CONTAINS 'upload' OR req.uri CONTAINS 'horde' OR req.uri CONTAINS 'wp-' OR req.uri CONTAINS 'php') RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, req.uri AS payload_uri

on_match.alert_message: ⚠️ [LOW] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} gửi Web Exploit Payload tới: {payload_uri}

next.name: Kiểm tra Web Server Spawn Interactive Shell
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress {ip: $attacker_ip})-[req_rel:REQUESTED]->(req:HTTPRequest) MATCH (p_web:Process)-[spawn_rel:SPAWNED]->(p_shell:Process) WHERE (p_web.exe CONTAINS 'apache' OR p_web.comm CONTAINS 'apache' OR p_web.comm CONTAINS 'www-data') AND (p_shell.exe IN ['/bin/bash', '/bin/sh', '/usr/bin/python', 'python', 'nc', 'perl'] OR p_shell.comm IN ['bash', 'sh', 'python', 'nc', 'perl']) AND datetime(spawn_rel.timestamp) >= datetime(req_rel.timestamp) AND duration.inSeconds(datetime(req_rel.timestamp), datetime(spawn_rel.timestamp)).seconds < 60 RETURN p_shell.pid AS shell_pid, p_shell.exe AS shell_exe

on_match.alert_message: 💥 [HIGH] XÁC NHẬN: IP {attacker_ip} đã RCE Web Server spawn Shell {shell_exe} (PID: {shell_pid})!

next.name: Kiểm tra Leo Thang Quyền Root QUA Sudo
next.query: MATCH (p_shell:Process {pid: $shell_pid})-[:SPAWNED|EXECUTED*1..3]->(p_sudo:Process)-[:RAN_AS]->(u:User {username: 'root'}) WHERE p_sudo.exe CONTAINS 'sudo' OR p_sudo.comm = 'sudo' RETURN p_sudo.exe AS root_command

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [CRITICAL] BÁO ĐỘNG ĐỎ: IP {attacker_ip} đã chiếm quyền ROOT thành công! Lệnh: {root_command}
